play_equipment.evidence: A dark round object sits south of the house, but it looks more like a covered hot tub or round cover than a trampoline, with no distinct lighter rim.

signals.notes: The central house has a dark gray multi-gable roof with skylight-like dormers and a patio on its east side; a dark round object south of the house may be a hot tub or cover, and mature trees border the east side of the lot.
